description.summary: follow and drive the window overview

protocol.description:
The compositor can show an overview of an output: the windows of the workspace it shows, moved and scaled so none overlap, over a dimmed background. The compositor animates the real windows; a desktop shell draws its own chrome around them (window labels, a workspace strip) on layer surfaces, following the progress and layout this protocol reports, so a half-finished touchpad swipe shows half-faded chrome.
Toplevels are ext_foreign_toplevel_handle_v1 objects from ext-foreign-toplevel-list-v1.
This global is privileged: the compositor only advertises it to clients it trusts, as it does ext-foreign-toplevel-list-v1.
Warning! The protocol described in this file is currently in the testing phase. Backward compatible changes may be added together with the corresponding interface version bump. Backward incompatible changes can only be done by creating a new major version of the extension.

interface.name: orbit_overview_manager_v1

description.summary: get the overview of an output

interface.description: Hands out one orbit_overview_v1 per output the client asks about.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroys the manager. Overview objects already created stay valid.

request.name: get_overview

description.summary: follow the overview of an output

request.description: Creates an object for the overview of the output. Each output's overview is independent: opening it on one output doesn't affect the others. If the output goes away, the object stays valid but receives no more events.

interface.name: orbit_overview_v1
interface.description: Reports how far the output is into its overview, and where each window is in the overview layout, and lets the client open and close it. The user can also open and close it (a key binding, a touchpad swipe, clicking a window or the background, Escape); every client sees the same progress.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroys the object. It doesn't close the overview.

request.name: open

description.summary: animate the output into its overview

request.description: Opens the overview, animating from wherever it is now. Does nothing if it is already open or opening.

request.name: close

description.summary: animate the output out of its overview

request.description: Closes the overview, animating from wherever it is now. Does nothing if it is already closed or closing.

event.name: progress

description.summary: how far the output is into its overview

event.description: 0 is the normal desktop, 1 the overview fully shown; in between while animating or while a gesture holds it. Sent right after creation and on every change, at most once per frame the output draws. An animation or gesture ends at exactly 0 or 1.

event.name: window

description.summary: a window's place in the overview layout

event.description: Where a window is when the overview is fully shown (progress 1), in the output's logical coordinates (0, 0 is its top-left corner), including any title bar the compositor draws for it. One event per window shown in the overview that the client has a handle for, followed by done. The whole layout is sent when the overview starts opening and again whenever it changes (a window opens or closes, another workspace is shown).

event.name: done
event.description: Ends a layout: the windows sent since the last done are all the windows in the overview. A done with no window events before it means the overview has no windows.
